versions.changelog:
- Updated portveil-mcp server setup instructions to use version 0.4.3.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.
- Expanded procedure details: now includes notes on browser timezone and language when moving devices, and how to keep browser settings consistent with the new exit location.

- Updated minimum required version of the server to portveil-mcp@0.4.2 and clarified installation instructions to pin the version.
- Added security recommendations: use a separate API token for Hermes, default to minimal scopes, and instructions for revoking tokens if needed.
- Setup instructions now explicitly note that upgrading requires specifying a new exact version, with a link to release notes.
- Minor clarifications and typo fixes throughout setup and security documentation.

- Version bump to 1.0.1.
- Updated SKILL.md with improved setup and procedure instructions, notably clarifying the use of split tunnel for Linux machines (now using full tunnel by default).
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

Initial release of the Portveil skill:

- Connects Hermes to Portveil VPN (WireGuard) for monitoring and controlling device VPN status and location.
- Enables querying protection status, exit country, live bandwidth, and controlling device location (move, rotate, reconnect, disconnect).
- Supports US and Finland exit locations, scheduled rotation, and adding/removing devices through Portveil MCP server.
- Provides secure setup using API tokens with configurable permission scopes (read/control/admin).
- Guidance and restrictions included to ensure privacy, responsible use, and compliance with Portveil policies.
